examples.title: 续桥 · 断点恢复
examples.brief: 虚构工作流 SaaS「续桥」需要表达任务中断后仍可从准确断点接续。
examples.method: 用两段相向的离散阶梯和连接缺口的一枚强调方块，把断点恢复转译成像素桥。
examples.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a completely original visual study of a fictional digital product concept. Design a singular abstract pixel bridge for a fictional workflow recovery tool. Two low, heavy stair-stepped ink forms extend inward from left and right, with a short narrow square gap between their inner upper edges; one muted terracotta square occupies the gap as a visible final linking module. Keep the two outer bases broad and the inner stepped climb gentle, with a quiet horizontal silhouette. The concept is reconnection of interrupted progress, not an arrow, an M, an animal or a letter. Limit the construction to roughly sixteen large square units, merged where touching. The bridge must feel coherent and stable, not a game scene. Visual direction: quiet artistic modernism, landscape 3:2 canvas, warm ivory background, generous breathing room and exactly one clear graphic protagonist centred optically, occupying about the middle 40 percent of the width. Large deliberate discrete square units, crisp straight edges, near-black matte flat ink with at most the one restrained accent described. Sophisticated proportions and clean negative space. No text or letters, no captions, no grid lines, no illustration scene, no mockup, no 3D, no bevel, no gloss, no shadows, no gradient, no decorative texture, no watermark.
